relations.statement: Transport with a loss ledger whose carrier does not match the target carrier is refused.
relations.hypotheses: Ledger carrier differs from the carrier of the transport target.

relations.statement: An empty loss ledger is an explicit claim of no loss and not an absence of a ledger.
relations.hypotheses: A LossLedger value with zero entries is present.

near_misses.claim: Citing only F001.S000 (chapter title) suffices as the F003 carrier.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A chapter title in F001 does not fill the F003 carrier field; carrier mismatch is refused (R1).

near_misses.claim: A missing ledger is equivalent to an empty ledger.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: An empty ledger is a claim, not an absence (R2).
